page.overview:
What is Victoire Weasley?

Victoire Weasley (b. 2 May She had two younger siblings, Dominique and Louis Weasley. Victoire started her education at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry between 2011 and 2014. She was also the girlfriend of Edward Lupin.

Victoire was born on 2 May in 2000, 2001 or 2002. She was given her name, which means "victory" in French, because her date of birth fell on the anniversary of the Battle of Hogwarts, in which Harry Potter, the Order of the Phoenix, and allies prevailed against Lord Voldemort and his Death Eaters.

Victoire has two younger siblings: a sister, Dominique, and a brother, Louis. Through her maternal great-grandmother, Victoire was one-eighth Veela. It is possible she lived at Shell Cottage with her family.

Victoire began attending Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry in 2011 or 2012.
